description: Returns the latest VR, AR, and XR headlines from VR.org's live aggregated feed plus VR.org originals, newest first. Optionally filter by category and by keywords: every keyword must appear in the headline, snippet, tags or source, in any order, and headline matches are listed first. Use a few keywords ('steam frame price') rather than a sentence, and omit the query for the latest headlines.

category.description: Optional category filter: hardware, gaming, software, enterprise, ar, or xr. Omit for all categories.

query.description: Optional keywords, e.g. 'steam frame price'. All must match, in any order. Omit for the latest headlines.

name: search_vr_news
title: Search VR / AR / XR news
